decision: Do not apply this candidate to the main editor. Four local median per-run pointer p95 measurements increase; one decreases about0.1percent and one about12.1percent. Fewer worker round trips did not establish an end-to-end improvement.
scope: Isolated at-most32 dependent same-cell/same-copy dab packets using unchanged spatial sampling and WASM numeric kernels, exact fallback/capture/transfer/validation/cancellation/ownership.
limits: Three clean alternating unprofiled pairs on one headless host and twenty paced synthetic movements per fixture; external host activity is uncontrolled. No sustained/high-rate/representative-photo/device/display/GPU/tablet/process-peak-memory or general60fps acceptance.

Native canvas-copy endpoints precede physical presentation. Three per-fixture p95 values are retained individually. Intrusive diagnostic/CPU profiles are separate and must never be pooled into the unprofiled timing comparison.
No separate release comparison was run for this rejected candidate. No main engine adoption, public/schema/OO/script/plugin/REST boundary change or source-resolution cap.
Full F06/T16/F14 and every other unfinished original-roadmap requirement remain active. Compact support-region transfers are an investigation, not a confirmed explanation for the regressions.
